verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single line saying Orama Cloud offers a JavaScript runtime for building agents and custom business logic. That suggests user-defined logic can run on the platform, but nothing shows it runs autonomously or in the background. The data-source note about differing update schedules describes how users organize data, not built-in scheduled automation. Missing for 10: documented scheduled or triggered background jobs, autonomous agent execution without user prompting, automation setup docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
